title: Heaven
definition: Heaven is the dwelling place of God and the present blessed state of believers who die in Christ before the final resurrection and new creation.
summary: Heaven is the presence of God and the hope of being with Christ.
christFocus: Jesus prepares a place for His people and brings them into joyful fellowship with God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Heaven is often reduced to sentimental images, but Scripture presents it as the presence of God and the blessed fellowship of His people with Him. To be with Christ is far better.

Believers who die before the resurrection are with the Lord. Yet the final hope is not merely heaven as an intermediate state, but resurrection life in the New Heavens and New Earth.

Heaven comforts believers because Christ is there, interceding and reigning. The hope of being with Him strengthens faith, worship, and endurance.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often think of heaven mainly as reunion, comfort, or escape from pain. Those hopes are not meaningless, but heaven matters most because it is being with Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Set your mind on things above without neglecting faithfulness on earth. Let the hope of being with Christ comfort grief, loosen the grip of idols, and strengthen holy living.
